source: Pesce et al., The Megamaser Cosmology Project. XIII. Combined Hubble Constant Constraints, ApJL 891 L1 (2020), doi:10.3847/2041-8213/ab75f0
measurement: Six geometric megamaser distances and velocities, 250 km/s peculiar-velocity uncertainty; independent of CMB and distance ladder
role: Held out from all parameter calibration; additive external constraint, not blind, no new raw maser likelihood fit
